source_title: Renova Technology Launches Renova 360 - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
One integrated solution. Every stage of the product lifecycle. Backed by 30 years of expertise.
NORCROSS, Ga. , Oct. 28, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Renova Technology, Inc. today launched Renova 360, taking its services beyond repair to bring reverse logistics, forward logistics, and product lifecycle support together under one provider for its enterprise customers.
The launch comes as Renova celebrates its 30th year in business, building on a track record of year-over-year growth. It also arrives as manufacturers tighten their supply chains and lean more heavily on Renova Technology's value-added programs for inventory management, configure-to-order, and advanced exchange. More manufacturers now recognize that consolidating these core functions with a single onshore supplier cuts lead times, reduces costs, and improves efficiency.
Because repair, spare inventory, and advanced exchange all happen in the same facility, Renova 360 closes the loop on returns and RMA (return merchandise authorization). When a product needs to be replaced in the field, a replacement can ship from stock the same day, while the de-installed unit is diagnosed, repaired, and returned to the shelf without ever moving between vendors. For manufacturers, that means faster replacements, fewer spares tied up in transit, and a clear view of where every unit stands.
"As manufacturers tighten their supply chains, they want partners closer to home with value-added capabilities. We are that partner," said Louis Pine, CMO of Renova Technology. "Being able to pull a replacement off the shelf in the same facility that handles the RMA is a game changer. Renova 360 takes us beyond repair, with a stronger focus on logistics side, expanded inventory management capabilities, advanced exchange services, and forward logistics, all built around our experience solving challenges over the last two decades."
Renova 360 is built around each customer's needs and includes four service packages:
Renova Repair: Depot repair and diagnostics, component-level PCB and PCBA repair (printed circuit board), rework and BGA (ball-grid-array) work, functional testing, failure analysis, and repair data reporting.
Renova Reverse: Returns inspection, RMA and warranty management, advanced exchange, spare parts and replacement inventory, and equipment tracking.
Renova Forward Logistics: Configure-to-order, kitting and light assembly, testing and quality control, order fulfillment, and support for large-scale rollouts.
Renova Product Lifecycle Support: Inventory management, including small parts and spare parts management, refurbishment, end-of-life support, asset disposition and component recovery, and storage.
Fueled by a record year of growth, Renova has also expanded its inventory management programs to better support configure-to-order, small parts management, and same-day advanced exchange, which is now the expectation in today's supply chain.
Renova 360 is designed for OEMs and contract manufacturers, field service organizations, integrators and dealers, and enterprise technology teams. It is especially well suited to commercial equipment with long product lifecycles, such as gaming and lottery systems and public safety and security technology, where downtime directly affects revenue and safety.
Renova Technology was founded in 1996 to meet a major point-of-sale and ATM manufacturer's need for a repair partner that could also capture repair data. That approach of tracking failures and sharing insights manufacturers can use to improve future designs still shapes every Renova program. Today, data is the foundation of Renova 360, helping customers improve new products and refine existing processes.
Over the past 30 years, Renova has grown into a behind-the-scenes service partner for a diverse portfolio of manufacturers, including many in gaming, lottery, public safety, and broadcasting technology. Renova was named Partnership Gwinnett's 2026 Most Valuable Provider and has been named to the Inc. Regionals Southeast list three years in a row.
Renova 360 is available now. To learn more, watch the introduction video at https://youtu.be/cjgfRfCvxds?si=na2VIpSL7ZMXeCX2 or visit renovatechnology.com/services/renova-360.
Renova Technology, Inc. is an award-winning repair and supply chain services company with over 30 years of proven success, headquartered in Norcross, Georgia. Renova delivers outsourced programs including PCB repair, rework, advanced exchange, forward and reverse logistics, configure-to-order, and professional services, trusted by industry leaders such as Flock Safety, Nanolumens, Wahoo Fitness, and IDIS Americas.
